name: 鍾孟雲
objective:
此課程旨在幫助學生掌握數位邏輯電路的設計、分析和實作技巧。主要包括數位邏輯閘（如 AND、OR、NOT）、加法器、觸發器、計數器… 等基本數位電路的設計與實現。學生將學習如何使用開關、按鈕、LED 顯示器… 等硬體元件，並運用基本技術 QuartusⅡ 模擬，以及 Arduino 開發板來進行實際的電路組建和程式設計。透過這些實驗，學生能夠深入理解數位邏輯設計的基本原理，並且能夠在實際應用中運用這些知識，為未來的數位電路設計和嵌入式系統開發奠定基礎。

This course is designed to help students master the design, analysis and implementation skills of digital logic circuits. Mainly includes the design and implementation of basic digital circuits such as digital logic gates (such as AND, OR, NOT), adders, flip-flops, counters, etc. Students will learn how to use hardware components such as switches, buttons, LED displays, etc., and use basic technology QuartusⅡ simulation and Arduino development boards to conduct actual circuit construction and programming. Through these experiments, students can gain an in-depth understanding of the basic principles of digital logic design and apply this knowledge in practical applications, laying the foundation for future digital circuit design and embedded system development.
